recognize_zh: 高倍下骨髓中一片小型淋巴球為主的浸潤，核圓、染色質濃密，其間夾雜細胞質較多、核偏位的漿細胞樣淋巴球與漿細胞，並散在含棕色含鐵血黃素的巨噬細胞——小淋巴球加漿細胞分化的組合即淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤的形態。
features: Sheet of small lymphoid cells with round nuclei, condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Admixed plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and amphophilic cytoplasm
Occasional slightly larger cells with more open chromatin, but no sheets of large cells
Scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages with golden-brown pigment
Adjacent fat spaces and a congested vessel at the upper right
describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows a dense infiltrate of small lymphocytes with round nuclei and condensed chromatin, admixed with plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells showing eccentric nuclei and amphophilic cytoplasm. Scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages are present. Occasional slightly larger cells are seen, but there are no sheets of large transformed cells, and mitotic activity is not conspicuous. Findings are consistent with a low-grade B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation, compatible with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: CLL/SLL shows proliferation centers with prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts and is CD5/CD23-positive without a clonal plasma cell component.
MZL cells often have more pale cytoplasm (monocytoid) and overlap morphologically, so MYD88 L265P and clinical IgM paraprotein aid separation.
Myeloma consists of plasma cells without a significant small B-lymphocyte component and shows CD19-negative aberrant plasma cells.
Mantle cell lymphoma is monotonous with slightly irregular nuclei, lacks plasma cells, and is cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.
